title: Father Peter Rinaldi's meeting on the Shroud of Turin

tellings.quote: a father Peter Raldi who Anne knew uh calls us up one day calls her up one day and says I want you to come to a meeting we're having a meeting about the shroud of turret

plain: Sometime in the 1970s in New York, a priest named Father Peter Rinaldi, who knew the writer Whitley Strieber's wife Anne Strieber, called her and invited the couple to a meeting about the Shroud of Turin, a linen cloth said to carry the image of a crucified man. Strieber tells it as something that happened to him, as one of the odd turns that pulled him toward mysteries beyond ordinary life.
